always_present_field: kv_placement_mode (always "default" when --kv-placement was not passed; the other 6 fields only appear once a real plan was resolved, i.e. never for default mode)

legacy_default_mode_real_capture.note: every pre-existing top-level JSON key (schema_version, membrane_version, mode, model_label, kv_store, kv_type, requested_kv, selected_kv, storage, gpu, memory, performance, no_fallback_occurred) is emitted exactly as before -- kv_placement is a new key, not a modification of any existing one

scope_limitation: --compare-kv/--gpu-bench JSON output (print_compare_json/print_gpu_bench_json) does NOT include a kv_placement key -- consistent with those modes rejecting --kv-placement at CLI-parse time (Section 27/cli_contract.json), not an oversight.
